name: GOV.UK Student visa knowledge of English
access_basis: 公开官方网页；robots 允许抓取
extraction_notes: english_level must come from the CEFR level table (degree level or above / below degree level). Exempt nationalities and qualifications go in conditions or documents. Set english_level ONLY in the section that lists the levels for both degree level or above and below degree level; leave it null in every other section. In particular the higher education provider paragraph ('This must still be equivalent to a CEFR level B2') describes one way to prove English, never english_level.
notes: 英语要求：学位及以上 CEFR B2、学位以下 B1，及豁免情形

name: GOV.UK Student visa documents you must provide

name: GOV.UK Immigration health surcharge: how much you pay
access_basis: 公开官方网页；robots 允许抓取
extraction_notes: This page covers every visa type. Only the yearly amount that applies to students is relevant: put it in health_surcharge. Do not use the amounts for other visa types, dependants or part-year cases.
notes: 医疗附加费（IHS）：学生每年金额

name: GOV.UK Tuberculosis tests for visa applicants
access_basis: 公开官方网页；robots 允许抓取
extraction_notes: This page covers every UK visa type. A Student visa applicant comes to the UK for more than 6 months, so only the general rule for stays of 6 months or more applies: set tb_test_required=true with that rule (and the listed-countries residence requirement) in conditions. Never set tb_test_required=false because of exemptions or short-stay rules, and do not list documents for short stays, returning residents, family, BNO or child cases. The tuberculosis_test_certificate condition is exactly that general rule (coming for 6 months or more, lived in a listed country for 6 months or more, living there within the last 6 months); the paragraph about children seeing a clinician or having a chest x-ray describes the test procedure and is never a document condition.
notes: TB 检测：赴英超过 6 个月且居住在名单国家（含中国大陆、香港）须检测

notes: I-20 必需；签证最早开课前 365 天签发；最早开课前 30 天入境

name: eCFR 22 CFR 22.1 Schedule of fees for consular services
access_basis: 公开官方网页（美国联邦法规电子版）；robots 允许抓取
extraction_notes: This is the full US consular fee schedule. F-1/M-1 student visas are non-petition-based nonimmigrant visas. Extract ONLY the fee for a non-petition-based nonimmigrant visa as visa_fee; ignore every other fee item and return empty policies/documents for sections that do not contain that item.
notes: 美国签证申请费（MRV）：非移民签证（非申请人预先申请类）185 USD。travel.state.gov 被 Cloudflare 拦截，以联邦法规收费表为准

name: 香港入境事务处 来港就读（中国香港）
access_basis: 公开官方网页；robots 允许抓取
extraction_notes: Only extract requirements for a NEW application for entry for study. Ignore extension-of-stay, dependant, internship and part-time work sections (their processing times and documents do not apply to a new student visa). Rules specific to Chinese residents of the Mainland belong in conditions, not in applies_to_city.
notes: 中国香港入境事务处学生签证/进入许可：资格、申请材料（含经济状况证明）、审理时间；无统一生活费金额标准

name: 香港入境事务处 收费表（签证/进入许可）
access_basis: 公开官方网页；robots 允许抓取
extraction_notes: This is the general ImmD fee table. A visa/entry permit for study is an ordinary visa NOT issued under an approved specified scheme (the specified schemes are listed in Note 1 and are all talent/employment/investment schemes). Extract ONLY the single-entry ordinary visa / entry permit fee under 'others' as visa_fee. Ignore every other fee item.
notes: 学生签证属普通签证（非指定计划）"others" 档：HK$330
